prompt: Create a dramatic vertical cinematic double-exposure movie poster featuring a handsome young Black man. Use a 9:16 portrait canvas. In the foreground, show a full-body version of the man walking confidently toward the viewer on a dark wet road, his right arm extended forward with his index finger pointing directly at the camera, his left hand relaxed in his trouser pocket. He wears an open black-and-white plaid overshirt, a plain white T-shirt, loose cream trousers, and black sneakers with small red accents. Behind him, place a huge close-up portrait of the same man from the shoulders up, turned slightly sideways but looking at the viewer with a calm, confident, mildly smug expression; he has short black textured hair, a faint mustache, and a small goatee. Build the background as a gritty monochrome collage: cracked light-gray concrete texture, bold black ink brush strokes crossing diagonally behind the giant portrait, scattered black paint splatters and drips, smoky white and gray mist around the smaller full-body figure, and a dark forest silhouette along the bottom with exactly two visible groups of evergreen trees, one on the left and one on the right. Lighting should be high contrast and cinematic, with realistic skin texture, crisp facial detail, glossy highlights on the face, dramatic shadows, and a dark moody atmosphere. The color palette is mostly black, white, charcoal gray, and cream, with only subtle red accents on the shoes. No typography, no title text, no logos, no watermark.
